decisive_items: a right breast mass noted for more than 1 year
Chest CT demonstrated a right breast mass suggestive of malignancy
response.rationale: The combination of a long-standing breast mass, recent skin ulceration, and imaging findings suggestive of malignancy, including BI-RADS category V and Chest CT results, more strongly support Invasive Breast Cancer than Paget's Disease of the Breast.

rejected.why: Lack of specific findings unique to Paget's Disease
